summary.text: Matt Philibert is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 98, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Jim Piwowarczyk.

paragraphs.text: Matt Philibert earned a high school diploma from North Fort Myers High School, an associate degree from Florida SouthWestern State College in 2010, and a degree from Madison Area Technical College in 2012, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as information technology.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a stay-at-home father of four, a political newcomer who grew up in Florida and moved to Wisconsin.

He said his campaign priorities include a $15 minimum wage, universal childcare, expanded health care options, a ban on online gambling apps, stricter regulation of data centers, and higher pay for public school teachers.
